GRAPH_COMPLETION.sql_skeleton:
WITH AllSales AS (
    -- Myntra Marketplace Sales
    SELECT
        'Marketplace' AS contribution_type,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM
        zs_observe.myntra_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
    GROUP BY 1

    UNION ALL

    -- LimeRoad Marketplace Sales (Forward GMV)
    SELECT
        'Marketplace' AS contribution_type,
        SUM(COALESCE(charged_amount, 0)) AS total_sales_amount -- Assuming charged_amount for forward GMV
    FROM
        zs_observe.limeroad_settlement
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
    GROUP BY 1

    UNION ALL

    -- Amazon Marketplace Sales
    SELECT
        'Marketplace' AS contribution_type,
        SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales_amount -- Inferred sales column
    FROM
        zs_observe.amazon_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
        AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' -- Inferred filter
    GROUP BY 1

    UNION ALL

    -- Meesho Marketplace Sales
    SELECT
        'Marketplace' AS contribution_type,
        SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) AS total_sales_amount -- Inferred sales column
    FROM
        zs_observe.meesho_sales
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
        AND order_status = 'Delivered' -- Specific for Meesho
    GROUP BY 1

    UNION ALL

    -- Shopify Own Website Sales
    SELECT
        'Own Website' AS contribution_type,
        SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales_amount -- Inferred sales column
    FROM
        zs_observe.shopify_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
        AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' -- Inferred filter
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    contribution_type,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) AS combined_contribution
FROM
    AllSales
GROUP BY
    contribution_type
ORDER BY
    contribution_type;
